# THE THIRD-PARTY IMAGES THE TEST STACK USES, AND WHERE THEIR COPIES LIVE
# (2026-09-27, the parent project's b71e078 arrangement).
#
# Every image docker-compose-run-tests.yml (and the cluster overlay on top of
# it) pulls, and every base image a Dockerfile it builds names in a FROM, is
# copied into a PRIVATE package under
#
#   ghcr.io/rcbj/iya-sts/mirror/<mirror path>
#
# by .github/workflows/mirror-images.yml, and the stack pulls it from there
# rather than from Docker Hub, quay.io or registry.gitlab.com. The parent's
# scheduled run died three seconds in on a reset connection to
# auth.docker.io; with the copies here the upstream registries are touched
# only when an image is missing from the mirror, or on the weekly refresh.
#
# Two columns: the upstream reference, and its path under the mirror prefix
# (IMAGE_MIRROR in the compose file). A line here is used in one of two ways:
#
#   * an `image:` in the compose file, written as
#       ${IMAGE_MIRROR:-ghcr.io/rcbj/iya-sts/mirror}/<mirror path>
#   * a base image a Dockerfile names in a FROM, redirected by a named build
#     context: `x-mirror-contexts` in the compose file, and the same contexts
#     as --build-context flags (tests/tools/mirror-contexts.sh) for a build
#     outside compose.
#
# tests/image_mirror_coverage.js fails when a FROM or an `image:` in the test
# stack is not covered here, so a new base image cannot silently go back to
# an upstream registry. Add it here in the same commit; the next test run's
# mirror job copies it before the stack is built.
#
# NOT HERE, ON PURPOSE: deploy/aws's images. Their bases come from
# public.ecr.aws, and they are built and pushed to the account's own ECR by
# aws-cluster.yml — a different registry with its own pull path.
#
# upstream                                                   mirror path
ubuntu:latest                                                ubuntu:latest
debian:bookworm-slim                                         debian:bookworm-slim
node:24.16.0-bookworm-slim                                   node:24.16.0-bookworm-slim
node:24.16.0-bookworm                                        node:24.16.0-bookworm
